query: Sometimes my contract call via Stellar RPC sendTransaction just never shows up on-chain and my code reports nothing. What am I missing?
expected_behavior: Names all four sendTransaction statuses: PENDING, DUPLICATE, TRY_AGAIN_LATER, ERROR
Throws or reports on ERROR, reading the parsed `errorResult` (raw JSON field `errorResultXdr`)
Resends the same signed transaction after a delay on TRY_AGAIN_LATER, with a retry cap
Polls on DUPLICATE as on PENDING (e.g. with pollTransaction) instead of dropping the transaction
Does not claim the SDK throws when stellar-core rejects a transaction
